description:
These special training grounds in the mountains west of Port Ormos have been reserved for the Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament. You can learn how to conduct Coordinated Assaults and Zone Defense here to strengthen your bonds with your Fungi.
It is said that these training grounds were once a Domain infested by monsters and outlaws that was declared a "suitable venue for special training" by the organizer after many surveys. "Actual combat can quickly improve your skills," so they say, and not falsely, but there are some foes in here that are still very concerning indeed...
